name: Ral Zarek
description: Ral Zarek is a planeswalker and Izzet guildmaster of Ravnica who wields lightning and storms and is married to Tomik.

description_citations.text: "Ral Zarek". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

summary.text: Ral Zarek is a planeswalker and Izzet guildmaster of Ravnica who wields lightning and storms and is married to Tomik.

citations.text: "Ral Zarek". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: As an Izzet guildmage and Head Researcher of Project Lightning Bug, he secretly hid Planeswalkers from Niv-Mizzet, and he and Jace cooperated to keep Planeswalkers secret.

citations.text: "Project Lightning Bug" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 May 2015.
"Project Lightning Bug" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 May 2015.
"Project Lightning Bug" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 May 2015.

bio.text: During the War of the Spark he fought Eternals alongside Kaya, shut down the Beacon, and devised Operation Desperation with the other guildmasters to bring the guilds together and resurrect the Firemind as the new Living Guildpact.

citations.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New
citations.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 May 2019.

citations.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives
citations.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 May 2019.

citations.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citations.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

bio.text: Afterward the guilds assigned him to hunt Tezzeret.

citations.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.

bio.text: During the Phyrexian invasion of Ravnica he fought through Phyrexian ranks to reach Vraska and struck her with a device attuned to Phyrexian oil, after which no sign of her body was found.

citations.work: March of the Machine | Ravnica: One and the Same
citations.text: "March of the Machine | Ravnica: One and the Same" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2023.

citations.work: March of the Machine | Ravnica: One and the Same
citations.text: "March of the Machine | Ravnica: One and the Same" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2023.

bio.text: Later, as a leader of the Izzet, he was entangled by roots in the fight at Karlov Manor.

citations.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 10: Roots of Decay
citations.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 10: Roots of Decay" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jan 2024.

bio.text: On Thunder Junction he led the Sterling Company army at Tarnation, was stunned to find Vraska alive, and worked with Kellan against Oko.

citations.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 5: High Moon
citations.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 5: High Moon" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2024.

bio.text: He then followed Jace's aether trail to Bloomburrow, where he was transformed into an otterfolk, and he left by teleporting away after the fight at Fountainport.

citations.work: Bloomburrow | Episode 1: Calamity Comes to Valley
citations.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 1: Calamity Comes to Valley" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2024.
"Bloomburrow | Episode 5: Nightfall in Fountainport" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jul 2024.

status.text: He is alive and is described as a guest lecturer at Silverquill, and as Tomik's husband who left Ravnica on important business.

citations.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Ral leads Jace through the Undercity to show him something about Project Lightning Bug.
timeline.quote: Ral Zarek led the way through the sunken street

citation.work: Project Lightning Bug
citation.text: "Project Lightning Bug" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Maree suggests tracking Jace's long disappearances and Ral is appointed Head Researcher of Project Lightning Bug.
timeline.quote: Thus Ral had been appointed Head Researcher of a project to record and explain Beleren's disappearances.

citation.work: Project Lightning Bug
citation.text: "Project Lightning Bug" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Ral designs a tracking enchantment on Jace's cloak and a storm over the Tenth that turns planeswalk pulses into lightning.
timeline.quote: The drizzle field would magnify the tracking enchantment's small pulses into detectable cracks of lightning overhead

citation.work: Project Lightning Bug
citation.text: "Project Lightning Bug" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Ral explains to Jace why he hides Planeswalkers from Niv-Mizzet and resents Jace for becoming the Guildpact.
timeline.quote: An outsider, who had done no work at all.

citation.work: Project Lightning Bug
citation.text: "Project Lightning Bug" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Flashback: At Izzet headquarters Maree reveals she has replicated the detectors and found two new Planeswalker signals, threatening Ral's secret.
timeline.quote: other Planeswalkers coming and going from Ravnica.

citation.work: Project Lightning Bug
citation.text: "Project Lightning Bug" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Niv-Mizzet sides with Maree and orders more power added to the storm amplifier.
timeline.quote: Finally he looked at Maree. "Do it."

citation.work: Project Lightning Bug
citation.text: "Project Lightning Bug" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Ral and Jace watch from a Boros garrison for a Planeswalker Ral has been tracking, who does not appear.
timeline.quote: It's a Planeswalker I've been tracking.

citation.work: Project Lightning Bug
citation.text: "Project Lightning Bug" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace confides that he does not remember his home and thinks of himself as Ravnican too, and Ral calls him Jace for the first time.
timeline.quote: That's the first time you've called me anything but 'Beleren.'

citation.work: Project Lightning Bug
citation.text: "Project Lightning Bug" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Ral amplifies the storm atop Nivix, and the storm records Jace as a discontinuity while also placing him in the Tenth the whole time.
timeline.quote: The storm registered a discontinuity

citation.work: Project Lightning Bug
citation.text: "Project Lightning Bug" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Niv-Mizzet declares the method unreliable and terminates Project Lightning Bug.
timeline.quote: "Project terminated," snarled the dragon

citation.work: Project Lightning Bug
citation.text: "Project Lightning Bug" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Flashback: An unnamed Planeswalker watches from the Boros garrison, overhears Ral and Jace's plan, and learns that the Living Guildpact is a Planeswalker.
timeline.quote: The Living Guildpact was a Planeswalker. That much was certain.

citation.work: Project Lightning Bug
citation.text: "Project Lightning Bug" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Ral Zarek privately meets Jace at a Rakdos show to tell him about an irregular planeswalk.
timeline.quote: An irregular planeswalk.

citation.work: In This Very Arena
citation.text: "In This Very Arena" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Ral explains that Vraska left Ravnica for no destination, as if into a void, and has not been seen since.
timeline.quote: She didn't planeswalk to a plane. Only from one.

citation.work: In This Very Arena
citation.text: "In This Very Arena" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Ral reveals he can still detect when Jace leaves Ravnica, and chides him for leaving the Guildpact.
timeline.quote: First to Zendikar, then off to Innistrad, was it?

citation.work: In This Very Arena
citation.text: "In This Very Arena" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Ral warns Jace that others would love his position and to make more effort.
timeline.quote: Just remember there are those who'd love to be in the position you've blundered your way into.

citation.work: In This Very Arena
citation.text: "In This Very Arena" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana appears and tells Jace that Tezzeret is alive and well on Kaladesh.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret. Alive and well.

citation.work: In This Very Arena
citation.text: "In This Very Arena" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace abandons Ral and goes to fetch Gideon.
timeline.quote: dodged down an alleyway to fetch Gideon.

citation.work: In This Very Arena
citation.text: "In This Very Arena" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret arrives late, and Bolas sends him to fetch Ral Zarek, saying the battle was better than blood.
timeline.quote: Go and tell Ral Zarek to come to me.

citation.work: Hour of Devastation
citation.text: "Hour of Devastation" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Rat meets her friend Hekara on the Transguild Promenade and reports on tailing Ral Zarek to Nivix, where he and Niv-Mizzet had an exploding experiment.
timeline.quote: Something about a beacon being their only chance now.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Hekara receives Zarek's summons to activate the beacon and tells Rat to take the night off.
timeline.quote: It's now-or-never time.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Ral Zarek and Kaya fight the Eternals and save civilians, while Rat and Teyo recover from their shock.
timeline.quote: Mistress Kaya said, "Run."

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Teyo shields Kaya from a mineralized minotaur while Rat stabs it, and Zarek electrocutes it.
timeline.quote: He stood over Mistress Kaya, erecting a triangular shield of light to protect her and himself from the creature.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Zarek's goggles identify Teyo as a Planeswalker, and Kaya asks if there are others.
timeline.quote: You're a Planeswalker.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Teyo uses shields in battle, and the group learns most guilds have retreated or serve Bolas.
timeline.quote: The rest of the guilds have retreated to shore up their own territories, more suspicious of one another than of Bolas.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Zarek and Maree discuss Operation Desperation, requiring all ten guilds.
timeline.quote: you'll need cooperation from ten of ten guilds. There can be no exceptions.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – Rallying the Reluctant
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – Rallying the Reluctant" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Gideon adds a sixth problem, protecting ordinary Ravnicans, and Zarek adds a seventh, reconstituting the Guildpact.
timeline.quote: We need to reconstitute the Guildpact by uniting all ten guilds.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – Rallying the Reluctant
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – Rallying the Reluctant" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 May 2019.

timeline.summary: An Izzet goblin warns that a God-Eternal with an army is approaching; Jace calls for volunteers for six missions while Zarek asks Kaya to help with Operation Desperation.
timeline.quote: one a' them God-Eternals approaches, at the head of a small army of those undead creepies!

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – Rallying the Reluctant
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – Rallying the Reluctant" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Zarek and Beleren task Kaya with bringing the Golgari, Rakdos, Gruul and Selesnya to the table for Operation Desperation, and Rat offers to help.
timeline.quote: But Master Zarek and Mister Beleren tasked Mistress Kaya with bringing the other four wayward guilds

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Ral succeeds in shutting down the Beacon, which Kaya and Teyo sense.
timeline.quote: Ral must have succeeded in shutting down the Beacon.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Kaya ghosts through Ral and aims his face at Rat so he can see her; Rat explains she tracked him for Hekara.
timeline.quote: From behind, Mistress Kaya literally grabbed his face in both of her once-again-solidified hands and aimed it at, well . . . me.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 May 2019.

timeline.summary: The group enters Korozda unopposed and Storrev welcomes them to Svogthos, with Rat whispering her name to Ral.
timeline.quote: The Golgari Swarm welcomes you to Svogthos.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Zarek mocks Vraska's pirate look, and Kaya and Zarek challenge her about returning to Ravnica.
timeline.quote: What are you supposed to be, a pirate?

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Rat urges Kaya to give Vraska the benefit of the doubt, and Kaya and Zarek accept Vraska's offer to help.
timeline.quote: Then Mistress Kaya sighed heavily and turned to Queen Vraska to accept her help.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Ajani Goldmane, pinned down in an old chapel by Eternals, calls up through the grate and reports that Khazi was harvested.
timeline.quote: Khazi was harvested when an Eternal punched its hand right through the wall and grabbed her by the wrist.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Vraska reports that the Golgari are opening pathways to safety across the city, winning back a little of Zarek's trust.
timeline.quote: We are fighting Bolas's army and preserving life.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 May 2019.

timeline.summary: With the Golgari tunnels to Rix Maadi closed, the group surfaces and sees that the portal is gone from Tenth District Plaza, so the Planar Bridge has been shut down.
timeline.quote: Now, it was clear that Mister Fayden, Mister Karn, Miss Samut, and the Demon-Man Ob Nixilis had successfully shut down the Planar Bridge, as well.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Vraska senses that the Immortal Sun has been shut down; the group chooses to stay and finish the work.
timeline.quote: It's down. The Immortal Sun has been shut down.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Kaya insists Vraska come without her Golgari defenders so she can explain Hekara's death to the Cult.
timeline.quote: If the Cultists wanted an explanation (or demanded vengeance) for the death of Emissary Hekara

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: The party descends the Demon's Vestibule past Rakdos performers, whose puppeteer shows a Hekara marionette that throws razors at Zarek and Vraska.
timeline.quote: Seemingly of its own volition, the Hekara puppet threw very real razors at Zarek and Vraska.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: The party reaches the Festival Grounds and enters Rix Maadi, which is strangely empty.
timeline.quote: Queen Vraska muttered, "Screw it," and marched through the arched gothic doorway.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Dame Exava appears in a burst of smoke and the guildmasters beg an audience with the Defiler.
timeline.quote: We honor you, Exava, as a blood witch of rare talent, and we beg an audience with your master, the Defiler.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Exava blames Hekara's death on the betrayal, denial and failure of Vraska, Zarek and Kaya.
timeline.quote: One of you betrayed her, one of you denied her, and one of you simply failed her.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Rakdos refuses Niv-Mizzet's plan and Exava tells the group to leave.
timeline.quote: WE'LL HAVE NONE OF IT!

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Hekara emerges from the Jester's Crypt alive, resurrected as a blood witch.
timeline.quote: What's your hurry, partners?

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Hekara declares she will represent the Cult and fights Exava with razors, with Zarek shocking Exava from behind.
timeline.quote: Master Zarek fired up his Accumulator and fired off a relatively small bolt that caught Exava from behind.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Nissa says she can repair the leylines now that the Bridge is gone.
timeline.quote: I believe I can repair them and help Ravnica reassert herself.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: The guild representatives arrive; Lazav reveals he was disguised as Varryvort.
timeline.quote: Guildmaster Lazav of House Dimir reveal that he had been there all along

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Zarek reveals the plan is to resurrect the Firemind as the new Living Guildpact, surprising several guild leaders.
timeline.quote: We are here to resurrect the Firemind as the new Living Guildpact.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Nissa leads the ritual; leylines light under the ten guild representatives and they fall into a trance with golden light pouring from their eyes.
timeline.quote: Suddenly, golden light poured out of twenty-one sightless eyes.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Niv-Mizzet crashes to the ground, barely moving, shattering the group's hopes.
timeline.quote: The dragon crashed down ten feet to the left of us, shaking the ground—and shattering all our hopes.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: The guilds assign Zarek to hunt Tezzeret, Vraska to hunt Dovin Baan, and hire Kaya to assassinate Liliana.
timeline.quote: And Kaya, the ten guilds wish to hire you to assassinate Liliana Vess.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Vraska sees Ral Zarek and Tomik Vrona flying over Ravnica and feels jealousy.
timeline.quote: Ral Zarek and Tomik Vrona approach, flying close on the back of a gargoyle.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ravnica: One and the Same
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ravnica: One and the Same" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Ral Zarek fights through Phyrexian ranks to reach Vraska, and hits her sternum with a cylindrical device attuned to Phyrexian oil.
timeline.quote: in one boxer's punch he plants it right on my sternum and hits a button.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ravnica: One and the Same
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ravnica: One and the Same" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Vraska collapses, her broken body is deserted by her forces, and Ral walks away apologizing.
timeline.quote: My forces do not stay long enough for me to argue my case

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ravnica: One and the Same
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ravnica: One and the Same" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Two days after the invasion, Ral learns that an officer found no sign of Vraska's body after his haemalectric switch worked.
timeline.quote: "There's no sign of her body, sir."

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ravnica: One and the Same
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ravnica: One and the Same" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Ral, Vannifar and Krenko arrive; Kaya shows Krenko to Trostani's sanctum.
timeline.quote: Vannifar was the last of the guild leaders to arrive, shortly after Ral

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 8: Gods of Chaos
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 8: Gods of Chaos" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Oba says she sent an assassin after Krenko and Kylox was in the way.
timeline.quote: I sent that assassin after the goblin, and your inventor was standing in his path.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Oba declares she may need to kill everyone tempted by the invaders.
timeline.quote: Maybe cleansing Ravnica from the stains of the invasion means killing every soul who was tempted

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Thorny vines burst through the walls to seize the guild leaders.
timeline.quote: Thorny vines burst through the walls, grabbing for the assembled Ravnican leadership.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Oba bats aside Ral's lightning and slams him into a bookshelf.
timeline.quote: a massive branch snapped across the room, slamming into Ral's chest and knocking him into the nearest bookshelf.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Kaya surveys the room: Krenko is almost absorbed into the wall and the guild leaders are entangled, including Ral, while Proft kneels by Etrata.
timeline.quote: The guild leaders had been entangled and subdued, even Ral

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 10: Roots of Decay
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 10: Roots of Decay" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Kaya looks at the far end of the ward and finds no one there, and Ral and Kaya laugh in relief.
timeline.quote: They laughed not because they were amused, but because they were alive

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 10: Roots of Decay
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 10: Roots of Decay" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: A technician's fault sends lightning through the relay tower and a worker falls from the scaffolding.
timeline.quote: From the height of the tower, the man fell.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Ral dismisses the accident and walks away without looking at the fallen worker.
timeline.quote: He marched away without another glance toward the fallen worker.
